summary: PathForge AI iteration 6 (Global Search command palette + Resume Builder + Founder Track) tested end-to-end. Backend: appended TestGlobalSearch (5 tests), TestResume (4 tests) and TestFounder (7 tests) to /app/backend/tests/test_pathforge.py — all 16 new tests PASS; full regression suite is 86/86 PASSED (~379s). Key backend validations: GET /api/search returns exactly 14 pages when q is empty; q='goog' surfaces Google under companies; q='python' returns >=1 combined hit across careers/skills/roadmap; nonsense query returns count=0 and ask_forge=true; endpoint requires auth (401 anonymous). POST /api/resume/generate produces name/email/skills/projects/target_role; PUT /api/resume persists edits (verified by GET returning TEST_HEADLINE_ITER6 + TEST_SUMMARY_EDITED_FOR_ITER6); GET /api/resume/pdf returns application/pdf with %PDF magic bytes and >1500 byte payload. POST /api/ai/generate-founder-roadmap returns exactly 4 phases and 12-16 nodes; /api/founder/roadmap persists it; /api/founder/node updates status and rejects invalid status with 400; log CRUD works with correct outcome counts (validated/invalidated); POST /api/founder/insights returns 400 on empty log (fresh user) and returns signal_strength+patterns+next_experiments after logs exist. Frontend on public preview URL: LOGIN OK, Ctrl+K opened the command palette (also btn-open-search), typing 'goog' surfaced Google in results, ArrowDown+Enter navigated to /placement (Google's company route), Escape closes palette. Palette Ask-Forge fall-through: typing nonsense showed data-testid=palette-ask-forge; clicking it closed the palette and opened the Forge drawer (data-testid=forge-drawer). Resume: /resume renders resume-preview (1270 chars, has Demo name); EDIT opens editor, editing headline + Save persists (verified after reload — marker present). Founder page: /founder shows founder-phase-1..4, founder-week-0, founder-node-0; adding a log via log-type/log-title/log-notes/log-outcome + btn-add-log creates log-entry-0; delete works. Roadmap: /roadmap shows track-toggle; click track-founder → link-founder-page appears; click track-job → link-founder-page removed. New nav items nav-resume and nav-founder are visible in AppShell. 0 console errors during the resume/founder/roadmap flow.

minor.issue: Observed 500s during long frontend session due to Emergent LLM key budget exceeded (litellm.RateLimitError: Budget has been exceeded, Current cost 2.97 > Max 2.93). This is an infrastructure/quota issue, not a code bug — all pytest backend tests (including AI generation, forge, founder-insights, resume-generate) had passed earlier in the run before budget was consumed. The Ask-Forge fall-through wire-up is correct; the AI reply just fails to render when budget is exhausted.

integration_issues.issue: Drawer opens and doSend fires (verified by network activity), but the resulting Forge reply message did not render in the drawer during the test — root cause was Emergent LLM budget exceeded (500 on POST /api/ai/forge). Code path is correct; retest once budget is topped up.

action_items: Top up / rotate the Emergent LLM key — budget is currently exceeded. This affects any live Forge/nudge/AI endpoint call from the UI (not the pytest run which caught the pre-exhausted window).

OPTIONAL — server.py is now 1326 lines. Iteration 6 added ~400 lines (search + resume + founder). Extract into routers/search.py, routers/resume.py, routers/founder.py to stay under the 700-line guideline.
OPTIONAL — /api/search 'roadmap' group scans the first 60 nodes then slices to 6; if a match sits later in the array it is skipped. Filter first, then slice.

OPTIONAL — ForgeDrawer effect ordering race: history GET can overwrite the msgs added by doSend(initialQuestion) if history resolves after the student message is appended (setMsgs(data.messages || []) is a replace). Consider merging or gating the history load when initialQuestion is set.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py = 1326 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold; strong candidate for router extraction (search, resume, founder).

COMPANIES list (30 items) is duplicated in the backend only — good, but consider promoting to a JSON asset for reuse by the frontend Placement page too (currently the SUGGESTED chips in PlacementSimulator are hand-maintained).

resume PDF builder: no page-count guard — an unusually verbose LLM response could produce a 2+ page PDF violating the 'one-page' contract. Consider truncating skills/projects/bullets before rendering.
Founder /founder/log DELETE returns {ok:false} silently on unknown id (no 404). Minor consistency gap vs other DELETE endpoints in this codebase.
Class-scoped fixtures defined as instance methods still trigger PytestRemovedIn10Warning across the suite; safe today but will break in pytest 10.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pathforge.py (appended TestGlobalSearch=5, TestResume=4, TestFounder=7 → +16 tests, total 86 passing)

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — all iter6 UI wire-ups (palette open, search, keyboard nav, ask-forge fall-through opens drawer, resume preview+edit+persist, founder phases/nodes/log add+delete, roadmap track toggle both directions, new nav items) verified with 0 console errors. Sole caveat: the actual Forge AI reply after ask-forge fall-through was not rendered due to Emergent LLM budget exhaustion during the frontend run (500 on /api/ai/forge). Wire-up code is correct.

test_credentials: demo.student@pathforge.ai / PathForge@2026 (used for frontend). Backend tests self-signup fresh isolated users per class where needed (founder_ctx and streak_ctx).
seed_data_creation: TestFounder created 1 fresh signup user with minimal onboarding, generated a founder roadmap on that user, and added/deleted validation-log entries prefixed TEST_. TestResume mutated demo-like data only on the shared test session user. No demo.student data was mutated by pytest. On frontend, the resume headline for demo.student is now 'TEST_ITER6_EDITED_HEADLINE_XYZ' (test artefact — main agent may regenerate to restore original).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter6 features (Global Search palette / Resume Builder / Founder Track) are backend + frontend verified. Backend suite is 86/86 green. The only intermittent failure surface for the next agent is the Emergent LLM budget: if 500s appear on /api/ai/* endpoints, the key needs a top-up — same env pattern as prior iterations. When testing Ask-Forge fall-through, note that the drawer opens correctly but the reply visibility depends on the live LLM; verify by network inspection of POST /api/ai/forge rather than DOM alone. Frontend resume for demo.student is now edited with a TEST_ marker headline — regenerate the resume to reset if needed. AI_TIMEOUT=180s is sufficient across the suite.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs in iter6 code. The only observed anomaly — no visible Forge reply in the Ask-Forge fall-through — RCAs cleanly to Emergent LLM key budget exhaustion at test time (litellm.RateLimitError, current_cost 2.97 > max 2.93). Reproduction: sign in as demo.student, open palette, type nonsense, click palette-ask-forge → drawer opens, POST /api/ai/forge returns 500. Mitigation: refresh the Emergent LLM key budget; no application-code change required. Secondary latent issue: ForgeDrawer's async history fetch on open could race with doSend(initialQuestion) and overwrite the just-appended student message (setMsgs replaces with the fetched history array). Mitigation: gate the history GET when initialQuestion is provided, or merge fetched history with any locally-appended messages.
